rules.statement: A mistake or oversight by a party or their attorney does not constitute a cause under Section 765 for obtaining relief.
rules.supporting_quote: (1) A mistake or oversight on the part of the Attorney-at-Law or a party to a suit is not such cause within the meaning of Section 765 as would enable such party to the relief under the said provision - Section 765. (2) 'Noting down the wrong date' cannot be considered as a ground that falls within the purview of 'causes' not within his control'
